The 1a+3f Cr basis reproduces the integrated intensities extremely closely (correlation about 0.99993), while the full-profile mismatch is near the measured noise level. Although the trajectory instantiated only this structural basis and the supplied comparable-Rwp report has no score, the observed extinctions and intensities directly support the submitted coordinates and P6/mmm symmetry, not merely the cell or an average framework. Because the composition is elemental there is no element-ordering ambiguity, and tested half-grid realizations with the same diffraction are crystallographically equivalent rather than distinct candidates. No materially different, scientifically motivated structure is presently likely to improve the candidate set.
